# Authorized USB devices - one fingerprint per line.
#
# This file is generated automatically the first time the tool runs and is
# intentionally git-ignored: it describes the hardware authorized on one
# specific machine. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
#
# Fingerprints are produced from the Windows PnP DeviceID (for example
# USB\VID_0781&PID_5567\4C530001231031117553) using the scheme selected with
# USBAUTH_HASH:
#
#   legacy (default) - the v1 Caesar-style obfuscation, e.g.
#   WUD\XKF_nklj&RKF_gfff\BIkVjGkm
#
#   sha256 - USBAUTH_SALT ":" DeviceID hashed with SHA-256, prefixed with
#   'sha256$', e.g.
#   sha256$1f2c0db1a4f1e6c0e0e9b6f8d1b1b3f4c9a1f2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f
#
# Add entries by plugging the device in and approving the prompt, or run
#   python main.py --list
# to see the fingerprints of everything currently connected.
